findings.detail: FX01 row has blank principal_amount_usd even though the source schedule provides a debt par amount in Par Amount/Units.

rationale: The FX01 artifact reports principal_amount_usd as blank for rows requiring explicit FX-aware principal handling. Raw source table 39 row 20 is a debt position and shows a concrete Par Amount/Units value of 515,349 alongside cost and fair value. The flagged blank value is therefore a source-grounded extraction/normalization gap, not a source absence or a check-only false alarm.
